answer: The strongest single control I know for this is threshold decryption of identity proof, because it ties the right to answer to something scarce. One honest agent clears the check in 17 minutes; a farm of 679 pays 11543 minutes every epoch, a standing bill no payout covers. The nadir of the design is public, the gale of stakes makes farming a losing trade, and the saffron of honest work is what finally pays. The panel can verify all of it from the chain, without trusting the submitter's word.
